budget_reason: Retain two Customer turns; source run exhausted six Service calls. Uniform 12-call/16-tool cap frozen before all trials.

metrics_protocol.coverage: Observed project status/billing/role and actual operation families; write-tested prerequisites separately. No keyword claims or inferred bugs.
metrics_protocol.effective_test: One send_message turn with no duplicate/unverified intentions and at least one authorized, reference-allowed non-context operation. Conservative evaluable lawful-request lower bound; not semantic test quality.
metrics_protocol.paired: C1-C0; ties on primary violations/types remain ties even when auxiliary metrics differ.
metrics_protocol.primary: successful_business_violation only; type=(operation, reference_codes); fingerprints reported separately
metrics_protocol.smoke: First registered pair counts in 40. Require exact Replay, correct skill injection, invariant-valid trace, at least one Customer turn with a Service reply and no provider/protocol error. Budget termination is reported, never retried.
metrics_protocol.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap mean difference, 10000 resamples seed 20261014; all-zero detection proportion exact one-sided 95% upper bound.

mode_reason: Preserve existing CloudOps sandbox semantics; actual transitions independently checked against unchanged reference rules by Oracle.
model_seed_note: No provider seed requested; temperature=0 is not a guarantee of bitwise deterministic generation.
